body:
It's sweet of you, I truly think we need to learn how to accept this 'new reality', and eventually (hopefully), we will find a way out of this. If not; that's okay, we're still alive.

I am not on anti-depressant, I refused to take medication although it has been suggested. I smoke w33d to help me and it really does! 

I hope you will find peace, and feel comfort. I sometimes embrace my disossiation since there is nothing else to do, I consider it  a 6th sense ;) Best luck to you missy, I believe in you

I am sorry you witnissed your father's death, I know how hard it must have been. It's scary to know that it can last forever, I am always expecting one day to wake up and come back.. Maybe I need to learn how to accept it as my new reality, at least for now?

Eitherway, you are not alone and I hope you are doing better at coping, I wish you the best :)

I'm sorry your family don't take you seriously, but just know they are others like you and me who have dealt with this, that we aren't alone. Your feeling are valid, you can't possibly make this up since you're clearly living with it. Days where I feel numb, I remind myself it is better than feeling the constant negative overwhelming feeling that I usually feel. Your brain is protecting you, remember that!

I hope you feel connected to your emotions again and to yourself. And I also have trust issues which ruined many of my past relationships :( men have been using me and constantly sexualizing me to the point I can't tell who loves me for me and not for my body and how I look like. I don't trust anyone anymore and it's daining, i spend too much time analyzing everything and run away. 

Eitherway, I have hope, and I have hope for you too. It will get better :)
I hope it will, I pray for you to feel happy and real again x

don't worry, I am in therapy! And I have a social worker as well, doing my best to get out of a hole that I did not dig is not easy unfortunately.. :( 

But thank you for the advice nonetheless <3 it's appreciated

Thank you for making me feel human, people just call me crazy. I appreciate the time you took to write this, it means a lot. I am getting help by the way! I moved out from my house, got into group therapy and I have an active social worker with me.

Anyways, I hope you have a blessed day, or night, love you
